newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Siemens Nixdorf sees sales leap. [CORRECTED 04:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Siemens Nixdorf sees sales leap. [CORRECTED 04:55 GMT]

text.p: Siemens Nixdorf Informations Systeme AG said on Monday it expected to double its Asia Pacific external sales in 1995/96 (Corrects to make clear reference is to external sales in the Asia Pacific region) from US$90 million in the previous year.

Executive vice-president Axel Hass also said the company expected total turnover in the Asia Pacific region to double in 1995/96 (Corrects to make clear reference is to turnover in the Asia Pacific region.)
Hass said he was confident Siemens Nixdorf Asia Pacific would achieve sales increments of between 40 and 50 percent a year over the next four years.
"We have a vision -- the number one European IT (information technology) company aims to become a $1.0 billion company within the Asia Pacific by the year 2000."

Hass said the growth would come from sales in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and India. He told Reuters he expected China to account for about a third of Asia-Pacific total sales, or $300 million, by the year 2000.
Siemens Nixdorf is the computer and information technology arm of German industrial giant Siemens AG. -- Singapore Newsroom 65-8703030
